instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Make fill-in-the-blank quiz questions from a piece of text, such as notes, a lesson or an article", and give it text (The words to make questions from).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:make-quiz-questions and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Splits the text into sentences and turns each into a question by blanking its most telling word, with the answer kept beside it; a sentence with no such word becomes a recall prompt.
